_about: The engine's own English sentences, exactly as speedkit/*.py (and the example-data stand-in) write them. speedkit/hub/i18n.py recognises them in the server's answers; <lang>.json holds what each language shows instead. Placeholders: {n} {n2} {k} {gb} {gb2} {mb} {pct} {port} are numbers, every other {name} is text (itself translated when it is a known sentence). Keep this file in step with the engine; an unknown sentence is shown in English as it is.
